jobs.occupation: SENIOR AI ENGINEER, PERSONALIZATION
jobs.description:
Who We Are
We are a well-funded, early-stage technology company on a mission to fundamentally redefine the way the world searches, discovers, and transacts, built on a philosophy that puts the user first at every step.
The user is not simply a means of transaction. They are a valued participant whose data works for them, not against them, enriching their world and their own experience within it, with them retaining full control.
Our mission is underpinned by proprietary, patent-pending technology built on a novel engine and system.

The Problem You Will Be Solving
The internet was built to inform the many, not to serve the individual. Platforms optimize for engagement, extraction, and consumption at global scale. AI has made this model even more efficient, with the user still largely remaining the input, not the full beneficiary. 
The problem is not information. The world has never had more. The problem is that people give away a lifetime of data without receiving the personalized experience it should enable.
People should not have to search. They should simply find.

Who You Are
• Highly talented and motivated to build products with people, for people
• You thrive in zero-to-one environments and find genuine satisfaction in creating from scratch
• A fast-paced thinker with a relentless desire to learn, improve, and raise the standard around you
• Able to inspire, elevate, and collaborate; you make the people around you better
• A great communicator; you express complex ideas with clarity, precision, and confidence across all levels of the organization
• Able to transform ideas into working systems and technical milestones with light speed and precision
• Highly ambitious and action-driven; you thrive under pressure and find genuine energy in working at the edge of what is considered possible
• Capable of designing and building production-grade systems in a fourth of the time most experienced and “sane” professionals would consider possible
 
What You Will Do
• Build personalization systems that combine behavioral modeling, dynamic user representations, and real-time context-aware content delivery
• Design and operate feature engineering pipelines that transform high-volume behavioral event streams into model-ready inputs within the latency and reliability constraints
• Build recommendation systems that scale seamlessly from cold-start to data-rich production environments without requiring architectural changes
• Implement exploration-exploitation frameworks such as contextual bandits, online learning, or reinforcement learning approaches that continuously optimize content delivery without heavy offline retraining cycles
• Build feedback and learning infrastructure that translates user interactions into measurable model improvements on a continuous basis
• Design evaluation frameworks capable of distinguishing genuine personalization quality from overfitting to easily measured proxy metrics

Minimum Qualifications
• MSc in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a directly related quantitative field from KTH, Chalmers, ETH Zurich, EPFL, or an institution of equivalent standing
• Deep theoretical and applied understanding of recommendation systems; has implemented methods from the literature and shipped them to real users
• Experience with sequential modeling applied to user data; recurrent architectures, attention-based sequence models, or equivalent
• Production ML engineering discipline; code that serves reliably in production, not only evaluates well in notebooks
• Demonstrated ability to take a recommendation system from research to production

Preferred Qualifications
• PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a directly related quantitative discipline; given significant weight in our assessment
• Research depth in recommendation, sequential modeling, or online learning
• Experience with privacy-preserving approaches to behavioral modeling
• 2–5 years of experience; exceptional graduates assessed on equal terms with experienced engineers
• A body of independent work; published research, open source contributions, or personal projects that demonstrate what you build without instruction

What We Offer
Expect the most talented, rigorous, and driven colleagues you have worked with; people who lift each other up and hold each other to the highest standard. This company is driven by ideas and innovation, regardless of age, position, or background. The best ideas must win and the people behind them recognized and rewarded.
A home for exceptional people and geniuses within their domain; those who have always known what they are capable of and have been waiting for the environment to prove it to the world, whilst first being seen and supported by their coworkers.
Compensation includes an attractive salary and meaningful equity ownership for an early-stage startup.

Equal Opportunity
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work and reach their full potential. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Application
To apply, send your CV/resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on how and why you would like to contribute to our mission. Upon initial acceptance, an online interview will follow shortly in Stockholm, Sweden.
Please note that all applications and interviews are conducted in English. Fluency in written and spoken English is a requirement for all roles.
All applications are treated with strict confidentiality

jobs.occupation: Senior SAP Application Expert, SAP Transportation Management System
jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO
As an SAP Application Expert, you will be responsible for configuring, testing, and supporting SAP Transportation Management (TM) solutions across transportation planning, execution, freight costing, and settlement processes. The role requires solid functional expertise in transportation management processes, master data configuration, integration testing, defect analysis, and business support throughout implementation, rollout, and hyper care phases.
Key Skills and Responsibilities that are part of your daily work 
Configure and maintain SAP TM master data, including locations, business partners, carriers, transportation zones, lanes, resources, and freight agreements. 
Configure and support transportation demand management, including Freight Unit Building Rules (FUBR), transportation requirements, and demand consolidation. 
Configure and test transportation planning processes, including freight unit planning, carrier assignment, route determination, consolidation, and Freight Order creation. 
Configure and support Freight Order lifecycle management, transportation execution, status management, and shipment tracking processes. 
Configure freight charge management, including rate tables, calculation sheets, freight agreements, surcharges, and freight cost calculation. 
Configure and support freight settlement processes, including Freight Settlement Documents (FSD), cost allocation, invoice verification, and financial integration. 
Support carrier onboarding, tendering processes, and carrier collaboration activities. 
Perform functional testing, SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect analysis, and validation of end-to-end transportation processes. 
Support integration testing with SAP S/4HANA/ECC, EWM, SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L), and SAP GTT where applicable. 
Analyse and resolve production issues, support business users, and participate in cutover, deployment, and hyper care activities. 
Prepare functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and support documentation. 

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
You will work with a team of highly skilled professionals on H&M Group’s advanced SAP platform, which supports operations worldwide. The role offers plenty of room for learning, development, and participation in various initiatives. Together we stive to achieve end to end visibility of our Transport & Trade flows to enable proactive, data-driven decision making. 
Qualifications
WHO YOU ARE
Your mindset and skills 
We believe you bring solid experience in the SAP Transportation Management area, with solid knowledge of system design, concepts, principles, and configuration. You are confident in explaining SAP Transportation Management (TM)-related topics to both team members and stakeholders across the H&M Group. 
You are confident in working independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, evolving environment. 
You are self-driven, proactive and take accountability with analytic mindset.  
You have excellent communication skills so that you can communicate information clearly and effectively. 
Mandatory requirements, both competence and tools: 
Solid hands-on SAP TM configuration experience (7+ years). 
Proficiency in Freight Unit Management, Transportation Planning, Freight Order Management, Freight Charge Management, Freight Settlement and SAP TM Master Data configuration. 
Proficiency in end-to-end transportation processes, including inbound, outbound and Transit. 
Proven experience in supporting carrier onboarding, tendering processes, and carrier collaboration activities. 
Proven experience in writing functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and support documentation. 
Proven experience in SIT/UAT execution, defect management, and business process validation, including integration testing with SAP S/4HANA/ECC, EWM and SAP BN4L,  
Strong ability to communicate SAP TM topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across the H&M Group. 
Experience with SAP transport and change management tools, such as STMS, Solution Manager, and ActiveControl. 
Experience in developing WRICEF objects (Workflows, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) from a functional point of view. 

Additional beneficial competences: 
Experience working in global SAP rollout and transformation programs. 
ABAP 
Fiori Development 

Language Skills: 
Fluent in English. 

Additional Information
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 
Staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. 
Included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 
Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to Swedish market. 
30 days vacation, health care allowance and good work-life balance. 
Additional perks and discounts from Benify. 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
This is a fulltime permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden. 
Apply as soon as possible by sending in your CV in English. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!

jobs.occupation: In-Vehicle Test & Verification Engineer  ADAS | Automotive
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: In-Vehicle Test & Verification Engineer – ADAS | Automotive
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced In-Vehicle Test & Verification Engineer for a long-term consulting assignment with an internationally renowned client in the automotive industry in Gothenburg, Sweden.
Are you passionate about automotive technology, advanced driver assistance systems, and testing vehicles in real-world driving conditions? This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the verification and validation of intelligent vehicle functions that improve safety, driving experience, and customer confidence.
We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who enjoys working close to the vehicle, analysing technical behaviour, and translating test findings into actionable improvements for development teams.
📍 Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
🏢 Work model: 100% on-site – no remote work
📅 Assignment period: 26 October 2026 – 31 August 2028
🎯 Seniority: Intermediate
🗣️ Working language: English
🎯 About the Role
You will work with the verification and validation of advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and vehicle functions, with a strong focus on physical in-vehicle testing and customer-relevant driving scenarios.
You will plan, prepare, execute, and document tests using complete vehicles, proving grounds, and public roads. Where appropriate, you will complement physical testing with rig-based or simulation environments.
Your work will help ensure that vehicle functions are safe, reliable, robust, intuitive, and suitable for everyday driving.
🔧 Key Responsibilities
Plan, prepare, execute, and document in-vehicle tests for ADAS and advanced vehicle functions.
Validate functional behaviour and performance in real-world driving situations and customer-relevant scenarios.
Prepare test vehicles, test objects, test setups, and driving routes.
Conduct structured testing on public roads and proving grounds.
Define test scenarios, acceptance criteria, pass/fail criteria, and verification methods.
Evaluate function robustness, availability, usability, comfort, and overall driving experience.
Analyze vehicle logs and test results to identify deviations, investigate issues, and support root-cause analysis.
Provide clear, structured feedback to software developers, function owners, system engineers, and other development stakeholders.
Work with in-vehicle communication, diagnostics, and data-logging tools.
Contribute to continuous improvement of test methods, test coverage, and testing efficiency.
Collaborate with test leads, fleet coordinators, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams.
Use simulation, HIL/SIL, rig testing, or automated verification where appropriate to complement vehicle testing.

✅ Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Automation and Control, Automotive Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent relevant experience.
Hands-on experience with complete vehicle testing, preferably within ADAS, active safety, automated driving, or other customer-facing vehicle functions.
Experience planning, executing, and documenting physical vehicle tests.
Understanding of verification and validation methods, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and deviation handling.
Ability to assess vehicle functionality from both technical and customer perspectives.
Experience analysing vehicle logs and test results to support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
Knowledge of in-vehicle communication, diagnostics, and data logging.
Familiarity with automotive test tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, INCA, DLT, or equivalent tools.
Valid Swedish B driving licence and confidence conducting structured tests in real vehicles.
Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

⭐ Nice-to-Have Skills
Basic scripting or automation skills, particularly Python, for log analysis and test preparation.
Experience with HIL, SIL, test rigs, simulation, or CI/CD-based verification.
Experience with ADAS, active safety, collision avoidance, or automated driving systems.
Additional driver training or experience as a safety driver.
Proving-ground testing experience.
Experience with customer-oriented vehicle testing or fleet operations.

👤 Our Ideal Candidate
You are a self-driven, structured, and practical engineer with a genuine interest in vehicles and advanced automotive technology.
You enjoy investigating how vehicle functions behave in real driving conditions and understand the difference between a feature that technically works and one that feels safe, reliable, and intuitive to the driver.
You communicate clearly, take ownership of your findings, and work collaboratively to transform observations into meaningful engineering improvements. You are comfortable moving between hands-on vehicle testing, technical analysis, and discussions with cross-functional development teams.
🔐 Important: Background Check
This assignment is classified as sensitive and requires the relevant background checks to be completed before the assignment begins.
The necessary background verification must be completed after candidate selection and before the start of the assignment.
Any discrepancies identified during the screening process must be reported and may affect eligibility.
Evidence of completed background checks may be requested during the assignment.

Candidates should be prepared to cooperate with the required screening process.
📩 Interested in This Opportunity?
If you have experience in in-vehicle testing, ADAS verification, automotive diagnostics, and real-world vehicle evaluation, we would love to hear from you.
Please submit your updated CV highlighting:
Your in-vehicle testing and verification experience.
Your ADAS, active safety, or automotive software testing background.
Your experience with CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, INCA, DLT, or similar tools.
Your Swedish B driving license and availability.

👉 Explore the opportunity and apply:
https://www.hykmann.com/careers

Your story
 
Must’s: 
Higher degree (preferably M.Sc. level) in Engineering or other relevant field.
Competence to lead and coordinate complex projects so that all external and internal goals are achieved.
This requires a solid experience of project management and good skills in managing the tools in our project management process.
Be able to independently manage customers and subcontractors so that we create effective external interfaces. It is also of the utmost importance to understand the customer's business and thus their real needs. This creates opportunities to optimize the customer value we deliver and the conditions for additional sales.
Skills to create and continuously develop a motivated project team that performs at maximum during all the phases of the project.
"know your numbers". The project manager must have good control of all important information (finances, schedule, contracts, goal fulfilment, etc.) and ensure that it is well known to everyone in the project who needs it.
Curiosity about how we can constantly improve ourselves so that we can create more customer value while improving our project results. Transparency and susceptibility to external and internal influences to improvements is of great importance in the same way as the desire to share own experiences outside the project
The group also needs a competence with the following focus:

The competence and willingness to share their knowledge with others

Why Beyond Gravity
To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!

jobs.occupation: PhD student in biomass resources from sustainable cropping systems
jobs.description:
Department of Biosystems and Technology
 
PhD project in Agricultural Science: Using agricultural crop biomass for biogas in synergy with the development of sustainable cropping systems
 
Note: This advertisement is abbreviated to fit in Platsbanken's recruitment tool. To view the ad in its entirety including additional information, please visit https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/jobs-and-vacancies/
 
About the position
Targeting the sustainable supply of agricultural crop biomass as substrates for biogas, the project will use a field experiment platform to investigate crop yields and crop nutrient dynamics in different scenarios for biomass removal and nutrient redistribution via digestates. The research will primarily be based on an ongoing long-term cropping systems experiment with four distinct systems: conventional, organic, agroforestry and perennial cereal.
The biomass resources to be studied include, but are not limited to: cover crops, ley, straw (from cereals, grain legumes and oilseed crops), beet leaves, and possibly wood. Studies on quantities and nutrient contents of different biomasses build on existing data from the experiment, to be complemented with additional sample collection and analyses as well as literature data or data from agricultural statistics databases.
 
The holder of this position will be a part of a national transdisciplinary center of excellence called Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC). Here, co-production of new and relevant knowledge is generated through collaboration between different scientific disciplines as well as between researchers and practitioners from industry and public organizations. The BSRC includes researchers and support from two universities, Linköping University and Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences, as well as about 50 private and public organizations involving all parts of the biogas system. It also has support from the Swedish Energy Agency.
 
All doctoral positions advertised within BSRC will be formulated so that they fit into the competence center's research plans and at the same time reflect our parties' interests. This way, we ensure long-term competence supply to both industry and academia.
 
Requirements
To meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).
 
You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
 
You should have a Master’s degree, or equivalent qualification, in a relevant field such as agricultural engineering (with specialization in crop production), agricultural science, agroecology, agronomy, biology, environmental science, horticultural science or another closely related discipline.
 
Your profile
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with an interest in sustainable agriculture and bioeconomy systems, and in analysing complex interactions between biomass and food production and cropping system sustainability.
 
Experience or documented knowledge in one or several of the following areas is particularly relevant:
agricultural cropping systems, crop management and diversification;
systems analysis and/or multi-criteria sustainability assessments;
modelling or scenario analysis;
bioenergy systems based on agricultural crop biomass resources;
nutrient cycling e.g. via redistribution of biomass resources and biogas digestates;
crop and soil nutrient dynamics and nutrient balances at field and cropping system levels;
statistical analysis and handling of datasets with multiple experimental factors and response variables

 
The project strives to provide knowledge for several societal sectors (bioenergy, food production, environmental impact), it is therefore important to have an ability to understand and integrate information from different scientific fields. The successful candidate should have good analytical skills, be able to work independently and systematically, and at the same time enjoy collaboration in an interdisciplinary research environment.
 
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Good communication skills and an interest in communicating research both scientifically and to stakeholders are important. Knowledge of Swedish is advantageous but not a requirement.
 
Personal qualities, motivation for doctoral studies and the ability to successfully complete the research project will be given considerable weight in the selection process.

Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment (TARA) at component, function and vehicle level

Secure boot, secure software updates and OTA, key management and PKI

Supporting compliance with ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156 and type approval

Supplier cybersecurity reviews and work product assessments

Platforms: AUTOSAR Classic, Linux/QNX and Android Automotive

Networks: CAN/CAN FD, automotive Ethernet, MACsec and IDS/IDPS

Secure development: secure software development, DevSecOps, SBOM and supply-chain security

Testing: security testing and penetration testing of ECUs and vehicle systems

Related standards: ISO 26262 (functional safety), ISO/SAE 21434 with China GB 44495, and the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)

Assignments with leading automotive companies in the Gothenburg region

The choice of employment at Cyber Instincts or working with us as an independent subconsultant

A small, specialised cybersecurity company with short decision paths and close contact with management

jobs.occupation: Senior Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Swedium Global Services is the growing System Engineering and Solution Company, offers services like Semiconductor Engineering R&D Services, Embedded Systems Development, Custom Application Software Development, Web and Cloud Application Development, Testing Services, Consultancy and Outsourcing services to our clients across the globe for an onsite and offshore business model. Swedium Global is having presence in Sweden, Finland, Poland, Czech Republic and in India.
Location - Onsite, Sweden
Job Title - Senior Hardware Design Engineer

We are looking for a senior Hardware Design Engineer having experience in BMS
Requirements
This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. You will take battery subsystem requirements and turn them into robust BMS hardware solutions together with system engineers, cell specialists, software engineers and manufacturing experts

Your responsibilities
Derive hardware requirements from battery subsystem requirements and translate them into practical design choices.
Define BMS hardware architecture and functional blocks based on system architecture, requirements, standards and certification needs.
Create schematics and PCB designs in OrCAD, including symbols, footprints and production-ready documentation.
Define the BMS interfaces to the battery system and contribute to the optimal EE layout of the battery design.
Select electronic and electrical components with the right balance of performance, safety, availability and manufacturability.
Prepare manufacturing deliverables for PCBA production and support test, troubleshooting, verification and validation.
Define AFE parameters, operating modes and BMS functions in close collaboration with cell experts, system engineers and software engineers.
Specify the hardware–software interface together with the software team and ensure clear, structured technical documentation.

The technical landscape
You will work close to the product and close to the details. The role suits someone who enjoys circuit-level problem solving, knows the trade-offs in BMS hardware, and can move naturally between architecture, schematic design, PCBA realization, verification and cross-functional decision-making.

What we believe you bring
BSc or MSc in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience in electronics/hardware development.
Documented experience in hardware design for Battery Management Systems — this is essential.
Strong experience in circuit and PCBA design and the confidence to work independently in complex designs.
Hands-on experience with AFEs, MCUs and BMS-related hardware architectures.
At least 3 years of OrCAD experience for schematic and PCB design.
Fluent English, both spoken and written.
